name: Stella Announcement Bar
author: mariastellatech

sections.description:
Stella Announcement Bar allows you to easily add a marketing ribbon to the top of your website to promote sales, new features, or webinars.

Built following WordPress coding standards and the DRY (Don’t Repeat Yourself) principle, it is extremely lightweight and performance-focused.

Key Features:
* Global Announcement Bar via standard wp_body_open hook.
* Fully Customizable: Change text, colors, and links from a simple admin interface.
* Responsive Design: Works beautifully on mobile and desktop.
* Developer Friendly: Clean, class-based architecture with hooks for extensibility.

Privacy

This plugin can set functional cookies when Pro features are active (for example, visitor targeting and dismissal memory).
If Pro analytics is active, AJAX requests can be sent to track bar views/clicks.

Site owners are responsible for obtaining any required user consent and for documenting this behavior in their privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the stella-announcement-bar folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your message and design under the ‘Stella Bar’ menu.
sections.faq:
Does this work with any theme?

Yes! It uses standard WordPress hooks to ensure compatibility with 99% of modern themes.

Can I use it only on specific pages?

In the Free version, you can enable it globally or for homepage-only display. The Pro version adds advanced targeting logic.

short_description: A lightweight, high-conversion announcement bar for WordPress. Perfectly designed for AI and SaaS startup landing pages but compatible with any theme.
